text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri annouces opening of campaigning for local elections to be held on June 13.
- Takeover by French firm Lyonnaise des Eaux of Casablanca water and electricity distribution is part of Morocco's plans to modernise management of local affairs.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak expected in Morocco before mid-May to co-host with King Hassan the joint cooperation commission.
- Study project for Casablanca subway could be finalised in September.
- Guinea-Bissau says it will support Morocco's claims over Western Sahara and withdraw recognition to the Saharan Arab Democratic Republic (SADR).
- James Baker, U.N. special envoy for the Western Sahara, ends tour of the region amid hope that referendum proceedings will resume soon.
- James Baker says solution to Western Sahara conflict was difficult but not hopeless.
- Morocco looks at closing Mideast secretariat set up three years ago to promote peace in the region.
